propositions: The code-review-verify spec emits {verifications: [...]} output with no decision polarity (FAIL/findings), causing _verdict_decision to fall through and score all cases as advisory regardless of gold label

Both gold-block case V-real-defect and gold-advisory case V-clean-rename must emit non-empty verifications lists per spec contract, so mapping presence to block would fix one recall miss but manufacture a false-accept on the clean case

code-review-verify must be excluded from parity scoring via a separate POLARITY_FREE_SOLVERS mechanism distinct from AGENTIC_SOLVERS to preserve the reason and prevent accidental re-admission of mis-scored cases

Excluding the two verify cases reduces n_gold from 28 to 26 (still above MIN_GOLD_ITEMS floor of 20) and removes one symmetric recall miss from both arms without changing gating verdicts or false-accept counts
